y-m-68-07.goal: Funda ukuthi ukunquma ivolumu indawo ye-cross-section kufanele inqunywe njengesibalo ku-x, hlela ukuthi ulwazi mayelana nesimo se-cross-section lwanele yini, bese uklama ngezindlela ezihlukahlukene isimo esiqinile esinevolumu engu-16 ngqo.

y-m-68-07.s.s1.r.b: Uma eyizikwele, indawo ingu-(√x)² = x, isibalo ku-x kuphela.

y-m-68-03.topic: Izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwehlukanisa: ulwazi oludingekayo ukulungisa inani le-derivative yomsebenzi ophambene

y-m-68-03.material:
Umsebenzi u-f wehlukaniseka kuzo zonke izinombolo ezingempela, futhi u-f'(x) > 0 kuwo wonke u-x. Ngakho u-f unomsebenzi ophambene u-g, futhi u-g naye uyehlukaniseka. Okungukuthi, u-g(f(x)) = x kuwo wonke u-x. Umfundi wabhala phansi amanani aziwayo luka-f emakhadini ukuze athole inani luka-g'(3). Wonke amakhadi angamaqiniso.
Ikhadi ① f(1) = 3
Ikhadi ② f'(1) = 5
Ikhadi ③ f'(3) = 29

Ifomula ayaziwa, futhi kukhona ulwazi lwala manne kuphela. (Funda ngokuthi: f prime of 1, g prime of 3.)

y-m-68-06.title: I-derivative luka-x^x: amazwi kabani alungile, ababili abafundi?
y-m-68-06.topic: Izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwehlukanisa: ukwahlulela amafomula amabili e-derivative luka-x^x usebenzisa ubufakazi
y-m-68-06.goal: Funda icala lapho idatha yezinombolo ephoyintini elilodwa ingakwazi ukuhlukanisa amafomula amabili e-derivative, yenza isibonelo esiphikisayo esihlunga ifomula ephosile usebenzisa amanani omsebenzi kuphela, futhi uchaze ukuthi kungani ifomula ephosile ibukeka ilungile ngenhlanhla ephoyintini elilodwa.
y-m-68-06.material:
Abafundi ababili bathole i-derivative ye-f(x) = x^x (x > 0). (Ifundwa: x ngamandla ka-x.)
Umfundi A: "I-exponent ngu-x, ngakho ku-(x^n)′ = n·x^(n−1), faka u-x esikhundleni sika-n, futhi f′(x) = x·x^(x−1) = x^x."
Umfundi B: "Uthatha i-logarithm yemvelo yezinhlangothi zombili, ln f = x·ln x, futhi ukuhlukanisa kunika f′/f = ln x + 1, ngakho f′(x) = x^x·(ln x + 1)."
Ukuhlola ukuthi ubani olungile, izinga lokushintsha elijwayelekile ku-x = 1, (f(1.001) − f(1)) / 0.001, lathola nge-calculator lafika cishe ku-1.0010.

y-m-68-06.s.s1.hint.0: Faka u-x = 1 efomulani yomfundi ngamunye bese uqhathanisa amanani.
y-m-68-06.s.s1.hint.1: Sho ukuthi amafomula amabili kufanele abe kanjani kuleliphoyinti ukuze idatha iwahlukanise.

y-m-68-06.s.s1.r.a: Lokho kuliqiniso, kodwa ifomula ka-B nayo ingu-1·(ln 1 + 1) = 1 ku-x = 1. Ukusho ukuthi isekela ifomula eyodwa kuphela, enye ifomula kufanele ingafaneli le datha.
y-m-68-06.s.s1.o.b: Isekela u-B kuphela. U-B ufinyelele ekusebenziseni ama-logarithm futhi uyindlela enokucophelela, ngakho ifanela idatha.
y-m-68-06.s.s1.r.b: Indlela ecushe akwenzi umphumela ube lungile. Kufanele uqhathanise idatha nenani lefomula ngayinye ngqo.

y-m-68-06.s.s1.r.d: Izinga lokushintsha elijwayelekile phezu kwesikhawu esingu-0.001 yisilinganiso esiphuma seduze kakhulu nokuthambeka komugqa othintayo. 1.0010 no-1 cishe kuyafana.

y-m-68-05.goal: Thola umugqa lapho isikhawu saphosa khona esixazululweni esiqediwe, hlulela ukuthi kokubili ukuhlukanisa isikhawu nokubala ngasikhathi sinye kuvumelekile, futhi uhlunge inani eliphosile ngokulinganisa ngaphandle kokubala.
y-m-68-05.material: Umfundi waxazulula i-integral enomkhawulo u-∫ x·e^(x²) dx (kusuka ku-x = −1 kuya ku-2) emigqeni emi-4 engezansi. (Funda ngokuthi: x times e to the power of x squared, dx.) Njengereferensi, u-e ≈ 2.718.

y-m-68-05.s.s1.explain: Ngumugqa 2. Njengoba u-u = x², uma u-x = −1, u-u = 1, futhi uma u-x = 2, u-u = 4. Ngaphandle kwalokho, u-x² ungu-0 okungenani, ngakho u-u akakwazi ukuba ngu--1. Uma ushintsha isikhawu sibe yinani luka-u, uthola u-(1/2)[e^u] (kusuka ku-u = 1 kuya ku-4) = (e⁴ − e)/2. Umugqa 1 ulungile, futhi imigqa 3 no-4 yimiphumela elandela isikhawu emgqeni 2.
y-m-68-05.s.s2.prompt: Omunye umfundi wathi lokhu: "U-x² uyehla kusuka ku-x = −1 kuya ku-0 futhi ukhula kusuka ku-0 kuya ku-2, ngakho akahambi ohlangothini olulodwa kuphela. Ngakho awukwazi ukushintshela ku-u = 1 kuya ku-4 ngasikhathi sinye, futhi kufanele uhlukanise isikhawu ku-x = 0." Ukubala ngokuhlukanisa kunika u-(1 − e)/2 + (e⁴ − 1)/2, futhi ukushintsha ngasikhathi sinye kunika u-(e⁴ − e)/2, futhi amanani amabili ayalingana. Khetha isahlulelo esifanele mayelana nalesi simo.

y-m-68-08.topic: Izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokuhlukanisa: ukuchazela umfundi omncane ngokuthi i-derivative yomsebenzi onesibalo ngaphakathi
y-m-68-08.goal: Ngenkathi uhlonipha ukungaqondi okungalungile komfundi omncane osefunde nje i-Calculus I (obona u-3x njengebhulokhi elilodwa futhi asebenzisa ifomula njengoba injalo), bhala incazelo equkethe ukuhlola umfundi omncane angakwenza yena nesizathu sokuthi kungani leyo mpendulo iphutha.
y-m-68-08.material: Umfundi omncane osefunde nje ukwehlukanisa imisebenzi ye-polynomial ne-derivative ye-sin x ubhale i-derivative ka-y = sin 3x kanje: "(sin x)′ = cos x, ngakho (sin 3x)′ = cos 3x." Umfundi omncane ucabange ukuthi uma ubona u-3x njengebhulokhi elilodwa linesimo esifanayo no-sin x. Lokho umfundi omncane akudingayo akukhona ukutshelwa kuphela impendulo elungile kodwa indlela yokuyihlola yena. (Funda: i-sine ka-3x, i-cosine ka-3x.)

y-m-68-04.topic: Izindlela ezihlukahlukene zokwehlukanisa: imigqa ethintayo yejika elinikezwe ngepharamitha (iphoyinti elifanayo, imigqa ethintayo ehlukile)

y-m-68-04.material: Ijika u-C linikezwa kunombolo engempela u-t ngo-x = t² − 9, y = (t³ − 9t)/3. Njengoba u-t eshintsha, iphoyinti u-(x, y) lihamba ngejika. Isibonelo, uma u-t = 0, iphoyinti lingu-(−9, 0). U-t = 3 no-t = −3 bobabili badlula endaweni yokuqala u-(0, 0). Ngenkathi u-t ehamba kusuka ku--3 kuya ku-3, iphoyinti lishiya indawo yokuqala, lijikeleza i-loop kanye ohlangothini lwesobunxele lapho u-x ≤ 0, futhi libuyele endaweni yokuqala. Ngakho ijika lihlangana lona uqobo endaweni yokuqala. Ukuthambeka komugqa othintayo kulungiswa isiqondiso iphoyinti elihamba ngaso ku-t (kodwa ungakhuluma ngokuthambeka kuphela emaphoyintini lapho u-x eshintsha no-t).
